body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.8 (naive base rate 0.86) that: capital adequacy ratio (Basel III, total) at 31-Mar-2027 as reported in the Q4 FY27 press release/Pillar 3 is >= 16.00% (Sep-2026: 17.05%). Our reasoning: Rs 200 cr more Tier 2 planned in Q3; RWA +4-8% in H2 at the realistic growth; small losses: ~16.5-17.5% central. Risk: faster growth or a further intangible/DTA deduction. Naive base: Laplace on the last 5 reported quarter-ends, all >= 16%: (5+1)/(5+2) = 0.86. Resolution: YES if capital adequacy ratio (Basel III, total) at 31-Mar-2027 as reported in the Q4 FY27 press release/Pillar 3 is >= 16.00% (Sep-2026: 17.05%). Source: Press release / Pillar 3 DF-11 / XBRL. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
